author: Ft Worth Times
title: Kelly Hancock addresses public safety and university oversight in recent social media posts
text:
Texas State Senator Kelly Hancock, representing the 9th Senate district, has recently shared a series of statements on his social media platform addressing public safety, fiscal oversight, and honoring veterans.
On November 10, 2025, Hancock expressed gratitude for law enforcement support in his campaign, stating, “Texas prosperity relies on public safety. Thank you Dallas Police Association for endorsing our campaign! #txlege”.
In a post dated November 11, 2025, Hancock addressed concerns regarding financial management at Texas Southern University (TSU). He wrote, “Proud to stand with @GregAbbott_TX in demanding answers at TSU. $280M tied to expired contracts. $160M paid before approval. Late reports. Missing records. This isn’t ‘staff shortages’—it’s systemic failure. Zero tolerance for wasting taxpayer dollars.”
Later that same day, in recognition of Veterans Day, Hancock posted a message honoring military service members: “Today we honor the brave men and women who have served in our Armed Forces. Thank you for your service, courage, and sacrifice to defend our nation and freedoms! #VeteransDay John 15:13”.
Kelly Hancock has served as a Republican member of the Texas State Senate since 2013 after succeeding Chris Harris as the representative for the state’s 9th Senate district.
